prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: a trodden country path surface: compacted light-brown earth with fine gravel, small stones and faint footprints (no wheel ruts, no direction). The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless repeatable tile of premium modern HD pixel art for a top-down JRPG ground map: ONLY a uniformly distributed trodden country path surface, compacted light brown earth with sparse fine gravel, small embedded stones and very faint scattered footprint impressions (not directional, no wheel ruts). Edge-to-edge surface, no border or focal feature. Strict uniform pixel grid: every visible art pixel a crisp identical square, hand-placed clusters of 3–10 art pixels with deliberate clear shapes; no antialiasing, blur, soft brushes, photo texture, random single-pixel noise, or checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy palette using 4–6 discrete shades per material; warm yellow-leaning highlights, saturated reddish-purple-leaning shadow tones. Orthographic directly overhead map texture. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination, clean base colors only, NO cast shadows, darkness, glows, vignette, or lighting pools. Critically seamless/tileable: pixel patterns on left and right edges match for seamless horizontal repetition and top and bottom edges match for seamless vertical repetition. Square image, an even pattern across whole square, no objects, text, frame, plants, or characters.
